name: Göreme Valley Cave House
niche_feature: Only 3 of the guesthouse's rooms are underground cave rooms carved into real rock; the other rooms (3 standard, 5 family, 6 suites) are not described as cave rooms.
evidence_quote: Our accommodation includes 3 standard rooms, 3 underground cave rooms, 5 family & friends rooms (for 4-7 people) and 6 suite rooms.
reason: Official site confirms real rock-carved cave rooms, but only 3 of 17 rooms; category fits as a partial cave stay.
page_issues: Rating of 8 is not supported by any cited source
Page does not state the full room count (17 rooms: 3 standard, 3 cave, 5 family, 6 suites) or that the guesthouse houses up to 60 guests

name: Kelebek Special Cave Hotel
niche_feature: 36 rooms mixing cave, fairy chimney and stone rooms; only some cave rooms are carved directly into natural rock, including historic spaces dating to the 8th century. Others are stone architecture.
evidence_quote: Some of our cave rooms are carved directly into the natural rock, including historic spaces dating back to the 8th century
reason: Official About page confirms some rock-carved cave rooms among 36 mixed cave/stone rooms; partial cave stay fits category.
page_issues: Official site now names the hotel 'Kelebek Cave Hotel' (page uses 'Special Cave Hotel')
Page says fairy chimney rooms are 'thousands of years old'; official site says historic spaces date back to the 8th century
Claim that the hotel bills its views as the best among Cappadocia's cave hotels is not supported by the pages checked
Page does not give the 36-room total or which rooms are cave versus stone

name: Kokopelli's Cave Bed & Breakfast
niche_feature: Single bookable unit: an approx. 1,700 sq ft man-made cave blasted into a vertical sandstone cliff, entrance in the cliff face and the cave 70 feet below the surface; one party at a time.
evidence_quote: When you reserve Kokopelli’s cave, you will be staying in a cave of approximately 1700 sq. feet.
reason: Official site confirms the whole unit is a cave built into a sandstone cliff; fits cave-hotels (artificial cave in rock).
page_issues: Page says views are from 200 feet above the canyon floor; official site says the La Plata valley is some 300 feet below
Price range $280-$380, rating 8.7 and 445 reviews are not supported by the official site; a third-party listing gives $220
'There is nothing else quite like it in the United States' is an unsupported superlative
Described as 'carved' in places; KOB and showcaves describe it as blasted out of the sandstone
TV/DVD library and gas fireplace amenities not confirmed by the sources checked

name: Lucky Cave Cappadocia
niche_feature: Official room pages (Deluxe, King, Deluxe Suite) describe rooms as built entirely of arched cut stone ('Kemer Taş Yapı'), i.e. masonry stone rooms. No page says any room is rock-carved or in a natural cave.
evidence_quote: Deluxe odalarımız 25 metrekare olup; Kapadokya’ya yeni bir soluk getiren dekorasyon anlayışı ile tamamı kemer taşlardan oluşmaktadır.
reason: Official site describes nine built stone rooms of arched stone; none stated as rock-carved or cave, so it fails the cave test.
page_issues: Category cave-hotels is not supported: official pages call the rooms stone rooms (arched stone construction), not carved cave rooms
Page title/name 'Cave' is a name only; the page itself already concedes rooms may not be carved
editor_note: Absence of rock-carved wording on the site is not proof it is not a cave stay: kept, scope unverified.

name: Melek Cave Hotel
niche_feature: Official site states every room is carved from rock; six cave room types listed (Deluxe Cave, Cave Double, Arch Twin, Double Cave, Cave Triple, Cave Family). Site was unreachable by curl; read via WebFetch.
evidence_quote: Melek Cave'deki her oda kayalardan oyulmuştur ve bireysel bir şekilde döşenmiştir.
reason: Official site says every room is rock-carved; fits cave-hotels as an entire-property cave hotel.
page_issues: Page names only two room types; official site lists six cave room types
Room service (24-hour), laundry and car/bike rental amenities not confirmed in the text retrieved
Official site content retrieved only via a fetch tool summary (direct connection failed); quote should be re-checked on the live page

name: Museum Hotel
niche_feature: Deluxe Rooms are restored ancient caves; superior, prime, imperial and pool suites are described as cave and stone architecture, with many named Cave Suites. Some units are stone, e.g. The Konak Pool Suite is a detached stone house.
evidence_quote: Our Deluxe Rooms, all of which have been implemented by a meticulous restoration of thousands of years old caves
reason: Official site confirms cave rooms and named cave suites, mixed with stone-built units; category fits.
page_issues: '30 unique antique-furnished cave suites' room count not stated on the official pages checked
Official pages mix cave and stone units (e.g. The Konak is a detached stone house), so 'all cave suites' overstates it
'Highest point in Cappadocia' is unsupported
Lil'a Restaurant 'consistently cited among Turkey's best' is an unsupported superlative
Infinity pool 'carved into the rock' and spa 'carved into tufa' not confirmed
Rating 9.6 and 1,243 reviews unsourced; founder's private collection claim not confirmed

name: Ottoman Cave Suites
niche_feature: 13 rooms: 8 rock-carved (kaya oyma) rooms and 5 standard stone rooms; five of the rock-carved suites face Uçhisar Castle.
evidence_quote: Otelimiz; 8 kaya oyma ve 5 standart taş oda olmak üzere toplam 13 odaya sahiptir.
reason: Official site confirms 8 of 13 rooms are rock-carved; partial cave stay fits the category.
page_issues: Page says the hotel is 'brand new'; the site's copyright is 2021, so the opening claim is dated

name: Peristyle Cave Cappadocia
niche_feature: 8 rooms in total: five cave rooms and three stone rooms, each named after a planet.
evidence_quote: Peristyle Cave Cappadocia has a total of 8 rooms, including five caves and three stone rooms.
reason: Official site states five of eight rooms are caves; partial cave stay fits the category.
page_issues: Official site does not say the five cave rooms are rock-carved, only that they are 'caves'
Official site does not say which planet-named rooms are cave versus stone

name: Romantic Cave Hotel
niche_feature: Seven rooms, all described by the hotel as historic cave rooms (mağara odaları); the hotel says it opened in 1970 with cave rooms and later renovated them.
evidence_quote: Tarihi mağara odalarımız, misafirlerine hem ruhsal dinginlik hem de benzersiz bir deneyim sunar.
reason: Official About page says all seven rooms are historic cave rooms; fits cave-hotels as entire-property.
page_issues: Room sizes stated as 30 to 40 sq m; official site also lists Eros and Agape at 50 sq m
Rooms are called cave rooms without stating they are rock-carved
'Fifty years of experience' is the hotel's own claim, history page dates opening to 1970

name: Seki Cave Hotel
niche_feature: Hotel built in 2015 by the Kelebek Group and described as a cave boutique hotel with cave suites and deluxe cave rooms; some twin/double rooms are not individually labelled cave.
evidence_quote: Experience authentic cave rooms, a homemade Turkish breakfast, and genuine hospitality for a truly unforgettable stay.
reason: Official site presents the hotel as authentic cave rooms and suites; fits cave-hotels, though room-by-room carving is not specified.
page_issues: Official site does not state that rooms are rock-carved, only 'authentic cave rooms'; some Twin/Double rooms are not labelled cave
'Hamam and Turkish bath' and 'pet-friendly' not confirmed in pages checked

name: Sextantio Le Grotte della Civita
niche_feature: 18 rooms are caves in the Sasso Barisano (Civita) (e.g. Cave 17, 18, 20), restored. The same complex also runs a separate Palazzo della Civita with non-cave rooms.
evidence_quote: This cosy 35 m2 cave with a bathtub in the night area ensures a pleasant and genuinely romantic experience.
reason: Official site lists numbered cave rooms in Matera's Sassi; category fits, with a separate non-cave palazzo wing.
page_issues: Page does not mention the separate Palazzo della Civita rooms offered by the same property
'Eighteen interconnected cave chambers' and 'light shaft' details not confirmed; official says 18 rooms plus an ancient church
'One of the world's most extraordinary boutique hotels' and '9,000-year-old city' are unsupported superlatives
Awards, filming-location and 892-review/9.4 rating claims unsourced

name: Signature Cave Cappadocia Trademark Collection by Wyndham
niche_feature: Boutique hotel whose suites are marketed as cave suites (Premium, Junior, Deluxe Cave Suite) with natural rock walls; the Signature Pool Suite is not itself labelled cave.
evidence_quote: Kapadokya’nın yüzyıllık mağara mimarisini çağdaş tasarımla birleştirme vizyonundan doğdu.
reason: Official site markets all suites as cave suites with natural rock walls; fits cave-hotels, carving details thin.
page_issues: Location is the historic village of Mustafapaşa near Ürgüp, not Nevşehir town as page's destination implies
Pool suite is not described as a cave suite on the pages checked
Official domain is signaturecavecappadocia.com (signaturecave.com redirects)
